historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects remote physical configuration, but does not distinguish a designed power inhibit from an attempted brownout/partial boot and provides no condition-specific evidence contract.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The 1/2/3 conditions must demonstrate an intentional platform power-inhibit decision, not simply failure to boot. Each condition needs exact populated slots, AC/feed state, power-request acknowledgement and proof that GPUBB rails never assert; the 4-PSU condition must then establish a normal boot and rail state from the fully restored topology.

original_test_intent: Verify the platform's minimum four-PSU power-on interlock: SUT and GPUBB remain off with one through three supplies and power normally with four.
original_method: Starting from a de-energized, workload-free chassis, have an authorized operator establish each approved 1/2/3/4 PSU slot population, independently verify the physical count, apply the prescribed AC and one bounded power request, collect power-control/BMC/rail/SEL and visual GPUBB evidence, return to a safe de-energized state between populations, and end with a complete four-PSU recovery boot.
manual_activity: A platform power owner approves the supply-count interlock and slot sequence; an authorized operator changes the physical population only in the approved safe state and observes SUT/GPUBB indications.
required_inputs: Four-PSU known-good boot and recovery path
safety_requirements: Reconfigure PSUs only in the vendor-approved de-energized state
Verify slot count and feed state independently
Issue one bounded power request per condition
Do not repeatedly attempt an inhibited population
Stop on rail chatter, partial boot, brownout, heat or unexpected fan/LED activity
Restore all four approved PSUs before ending
Do not leave an undersupplied chassis energized
agent_execution_scope: Verify condition map and safe-state approvals
Collect precondition inventory and power state
Record BMC power-control response, rails, SEL and reachability for each operator-built population
Correlate no-power behavior with an intentional inhibit indication
Observe the final four-PSU boot and stable health
Archive results without manipulating hardware or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Approve minimum-PSU rule and physical sequence
Supervise isolation, population change and power requests
Observe SUT and GPUBB physical state
Stop on any partial energization or hardware concern

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek provides no Agent command and captures only operator-reported power state. That misses BMC power-request response, inhibit reason, rails and per-condition event evidence needed to distinguish correct interlock behavior from an unsafe failed start.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only BMC/Redfish/IPMI power, sensor and SEL collection synchronized to one operator-controlled power request for each physically verified population; never automate PSU reconfiguration or retries.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact 1, 2, 3 and 4 PSU sequence and 20-minute estimate remain; no population may be skipped or inferred from another.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each supply count as a separately photographed cold configuration, correlate one power request with controller/rail/GPUBB response, then fully isolate before rebuilding the next condition and finish on a healthy four-PSU boot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds proof of intentional inhibit, rail-level nonassertion, bounded requests, between-condition safe-state verification and final topology recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A dark front panel does not distinguish correct policy enforcement from missing AC, wrong cabling, a failed controller or a brownout that briefly energized GPUBB.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated starts below the approved power budget can stress converters or create partial rail sequencing; physical count and GPUBB state cannot be established by the Agent alone.

project_override_considerations: Approve whether all four specific slots are mandatory or any four supplies satisfy the rule, the expected controller reason for inhibiting 1-3, the GPUBB rail/indicator oracle, dwell/timeout and the exact isolation step between configurations.
expected_evidence: Approved minimum-PSU SPEC and 1/2/3/4 slot/population matrix
Chassis/BMC/PSU/GPUBB identity, isolation procedure, operator/observer and timestamps
Photographic population proof for each condition
Per-condition power request, controller response, rails, GPUBB state, sensors and complete SEL
Proof of intentional no-power for 1-3 and normal power/boot for 4
Final four-PSU health, preserved logs, no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently specify the same four-population threshold and matching SUT/GPUBB off/off/off/on behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test purpose and acceptance matrix are explicit. Safe execution awaits the platform SPEC, operator and transition procedure, making it REQUIRES rather than semantically BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Separates correct minimum-population interlock behavior from an unsafe failed start by requiring controller, rail and GPUBB evidence for every physical configuration.
independent_technical_reasoning: A no-power result is meaningful only when AC is present, the requested population is confirmed and the power controller deliberately refuses rail enablement. Otherwise the same observation can result from a cabling error or dead PSU. Conversely, any momentary GPUBB rail assertion in a 1-3 PSU condition is a critical sequencing deviation even if the chassis later appears off, so time-correlated rail and event evidence is essential.
